scope: Independent mechanism review only: full assembler, full final schema/partonomy validator and synthetic controls. This does not approve any vitamin/mixture scientific decision, payload or peer conclusion.
checks_by_inspection: Assembler pins parent and fragment bytes; preserves case/source/occurrence identities; accounts for entire original no-proposal cohort; requires separate author/reviewer labels; remaps superseded proposal backlinks only for explicitly reviewed cases; retains original case membership and forbids duplicate active owner paths.

Final validator replays guarded writer for all payloads, checks before hashes against maintained bytes and frozen baseline commit, prevents new identifier collision, overlays ignored-inclusive maintained catalog for native partonomy, runs native strict schema command, checks full maintained data surfaces and published original report bytes.
Root helper does not itself conduct scientific review. Read actual peer receipts and confirm each declared reviewed case and exact proposal hash before configuring group review metadata.

trust_boundary.finding: Peer receipt JSON contents are not parsed by assembler; configured author/reviewer/reviewed_case_ids are trusted after receipt-byte hash check. The accepted synthetic control intentionally uses only {control:true}.
trust_boundary.severity: Integration limitation; not a claim that real scientific review is absent.
trust_boundary.required_root_verification: Before final-selection, verify actual independent receipt author, complete case assessments, exact input/payload hashes and finding resolutions. Configuration must derive from that verified receipt, not merely a hashable JSON file.
